download_data_from_links: download data artefacts from a list of URLs or Kaggle datasets to a local directory
lazily_download_file: lazily fetch a file from a URL and write it into an output directory with progress tracking
validate_artefact_checksum: validate the MD5 checksum of a downloaded artefact file against an expected checksum value
extract_dataset_and_update_status: extract a downloadable dataset from artifacts into TFRecord shards and mark its status as ready
lazily_download_artifacts: download all artifacts for a named dataset to a given path, skipping manual-download datasets
